notes.subject: snek
notes.rationale: snek em i Tok Pisin tok bilong snow, i no binatang snek; Tok Pisin i no gat narapela tok bilong snow

notes.subject: kaikai kamap
notes.rationale: קיץ em i taim bilong kaikai bilong gaden i kamap, samting i no save stap long Tok Pisin narapela pasin

notes.subject: snek/ren
notes.rationale: tupela piksa — samting i no save kamap long taim bilong en — olsem nem gut long man tingting nating

translation: Olsem snek long taim bilong kaikai kamap, na olsem ren long taim bilong kotim kaikai — olsem na ⟨i⟩ no stret long man long tingting long givim kaikai bilong nem long ol man ol i tingting nating.
